explanation: The real line is 'No. I am your father.' Vader is answering Luke's charge that he killed Luke's father, so he never says Luke's name.

issues.note: The explanation's 'so he never says Luke's name' overreaches. In the same scene Vader calls him 'Luke' more than once ('Luke, you can destroy the Emperor'); only the famous line lacks the name. Reword to something like 'so the line itself never uses Luke's name'. Recorded as addition x1.

issues.note: The explanation ends 'so he never says Luke's name'. As written that is false: in the same scene Vader says 'Luke, you do not yet realize your importance' and, right after the reveal, 'Luke, you can destroy the Emperor'. Limit it to the line itself (the line does not begin with Luke's name) or cut the clause.

Worth redrafting under a new id with the explanation limited to the line itself.
